claims: Kennesaw State University is an R2 public research university in Georgia.
Kennesaw State University has campuses in Kennesaw and Marietta, Georgia.
Kennesaw State University serves over 50,000 students.
Kennesaw State University was founded in 1963.
Kennesaw State University offers more than 190 undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral programs.
Kennesaw State University has two main campuses.
Kennesaw State University holds an R2 Carnegie-designated status as a doctoral research university.
Kennesaw State University offers programs in computer science, engineering, and nursing.
Kennesaw State University has a 69% acceptance rate for 2024-2025.
Applicants to Kennesaw State University typically have a 1020-1220 SAT score range.
Applicants to Kennesaw State University typically have a 19-25 ACT score range.
Kennesaw State University competes in NCAA Division I as the Owls.
Kennesaw State University offers sports including football and basketball.
Students at Kennesaw State University represent over 100 countries.
The Kennesaw Campus of Kennesaw State University is located at 1000 Chastain Road, Kennesaw, GA 30144.
The Marietta Campus of Kennesaw State University is located at 1100 South Marietta Pkwy, Marietta, GA 30060.
Kennesaw State University features award-winning dining, according to Kennesaw State University's website.
Kennesaw State University's application deadline for regular admission is July 1.
According to Kennesaw State University's undergraduate admissions, students with a 3.2 GPA or higher may be admitted without SAT/ACT scores for certain semesters.
